# Upmetrics

> AI-powered business planning software that helps entrepreneurs create lender-ready plans, financial forecasts, and pitch decks in minutes.

Upmetrics provides an integrated platform combining AI assistants, automated financial forecasting, and strategic planning tools. The platform serves diverse users including startups, consultants, accelerators, and educational institutions, with integrations for QuickBooks and Xero to streamline financial workflows.

## Key Topics

- AI Business Plan Generator
- Financial Forecasting
- Automated Financials
- Pitch Deck Generator
- AI Assistants
- Business Planning Software
- Financial Projections
- Strategic Planning
- White-Label Solution
- Industry Research

- Xero Integration
- Startup Planning
- Fundraising
- Business Validation

## Core Features

- [AI Business Plan Generator – Create Plans in Minutes](https://upmetrics.co/features/ai-plan-generator): AI Business Plan Generator feature: create lender-ready plans in minutes without writing skills.
- [Financial Forecasting Software | Automatic & Accurate](https://upmetrics.co/features/financial-forecasting): Financial forecasting feature with automated projections and scenario planning for startups.
- [AI Pitch Deck Generator: Create Perfect Pitch to Impress Investors](https://upmetrics.co/features/pitch-deck): AI Pitch Deck Generator for creating investor-ready presentations in minutes.
- [Upmetrics AI Assistants | AI Business Plan Writing, Research & Forecasting](https://upmetrics.co/features/upmetrics-ai-assistants): AI assistants for plan writing, market research, financial forecasting, and business guidance.
- [Strategic Planning Tools | Upmetrics](https://upmetrics.co/features/strategic-planning): Strategic planning tools for collaborative business strategy development and execution.
- [AI-Assisted Industry Research Reports | Upmetrics](https://upmetrics.co/features/industry-research): AI-assisted industry research reports with credible data for competitive and market analysis.

## Business Solutions

- [Secure Your Business Funding Easily with Upmetrics](https://upmetrics.co/solutions/secure-funding-loans): Fundraising solution: lender-ready plans, projections, and pitch decks for securing loans.

- [E2 Visa Business Plan | Upmetrics](https://upmetrics.co/solutions/e2-visa-business-plan): Specialized E-2 visa business plan solution for international entrepreneurs seeking U.S. approval.
- [Upmetrics: Business Planning Tool for Consultants & Advisors](https://upmetrics.co/solutions/business-consultants-advisors): Consultant platform with client management, customizable templates, and automated financials.
- [Business Planning Tool for Incubators + Accelerators](https://upmetrics.co/solutions/accelerators-and-incubators): Startup support platform for accelerators and incubators with mentorship and tracking tools.
- [Business Planning Tools for Schools & Educators | 30% Off](https://upmetrics.co/solutions/business-schools-educators): Educational platform for business schools with 30% educator discount and curriculum tools.
